scores.category: Memorability (functional: onboarding, empty states, data moments, signature detail)
scores.evidence: Seven-step spotlight tutorial on real UI including a live field with its stepper pair and 'from wearable' chip (tour-5-1440.png, tour-3-390.png), baseline band as the signature detail on tiles, fields and Trends, the 15-segment status ring with a verified one-time sweep, and the chamfered key family give an instrument-panel identity no health app uses. Gap: empty states (In transit, Inbox, Delivered, 'No messages') are still one icon and one line; Settings has no designed moment.

All token pairs and every rendered text node pass in both themes; crew tabs are a roving tablist named 'Commander, Act now'; focus follows the cut; primary flow 6 keyboard actions at three widths; tour traps focus, Esc and arrows work. Defect: the Review step's Save check-in sits at the bottom of a 2,200px page after five expanded findings (flow-review-1440.png y 1900), so on a touch tablet the primary action of the core flow is a long scroll away; the footer is not sticky (checkin.css:163).

uxWeighting: Product goal 'easy and quick for astronauts' is met on the main path: one answer and one next action on Today, a prefilled five-step check-in saved in 6 keyboard actions, cue cards that say where to put the number and how to measure it on board, and a tutorial that rings the actual Check-in item and a live field. What still costs a crew member time is at the end of the flow and in the second-tier screens: the Review step buries Save under five long findings, Ground and Body map spend their first screen on empty or unrelated blocks, and the day-bar hint asks for a 4px tap. Fix those and the product is at the standard.
